title: Ryan Breslow is raising up to $27M in pay-to-play bridge funding to save Bolt | TechCrunch
summary: The company, which hit an $11 billion valuation in early 2022 before plummeting 97% to $300 million, is now raising a bridge round of up to $27 million, Breslow told TechCrunch.
